3008-170982791 F -(212)922-0880 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT 9881 THIS ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT made as of this 12" day of October, 2007 (this “Agreement"), by and between West 122"d Street Associates Limited Partnership, having an office c/o The Arker Companies, 930 Broadway, Woodmere, New York 11598 ( the “Seller"), and 220 Saint Nicholas Partners, LLC having an office c/o Kyle R Rawlins, 599 West End Avenue, 8"h Floor, New York, New York 10024 (the “Developer"). RECITALS: A.Seller is the fee owner of the land described inExhibit A hereto,which land is designated as Tax Lot 2 in Block 1927 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County (the "Tax Map"), and known by the street addresses of 222 St. Nicholas Ave., New (as hereinafter defined) now or hereafter located onSeller's Land (herein called "Seller's Improvements") (the Seller's Land and the Seller's Improvements are herein collectively called "Seller's Property"). B.Developer is the fee owner of the land described in Exhibit B hereto, which land is designated as Tax Lot 1 in Block 1927 on the Tax Map, and known by the street addresses of 220 Saint Nicholas Ave. (a/k/a 273 West 121 street), New York, New York (which land is herein called "Developer's Land"), together with the Improvements now or hereafter located on Developer's Improvements are herein collectively called "Developer's Property"). C. As of the date hereof, theSeller's Improvements consist of thebuilding(s) located on Seller's Land (such buildings, as the same exist as of the date hereof, being herein called 'Seller'sExistingBuilding"). D.As of the date hereof, Developer contemplates re-developing Developer's Property, which re-development may include the construction upon Developer's Land of one or more buildings (collectively, as the same shall hereafter be constructed, being herein called "Developer's Prospective Building"). The intended size of Developer's Prospective Building is greater than that which would be permitted by the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) assuming Developer's Property remained a separate zoning lot under the Zoning Resolution. E.Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are part of a single block (i.e., Block 1927 on the Tax Map).

F.Pursuant to a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the "Declaration"), dated as of the date hereof,betweenSeller andDeveloper,theSeller'sLand and theDeveloper's Land have been merged and combined into a single “zoning lot", as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot, as the same may be modified from time to time pursuant to Section 2 of the Declaration, being herein called the "Combined Zoning Lot"). The Declaration is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the Office of the Register of the City of New York (New York County). G. The parties hereto intend, pursuant to this Agreement, to (i) effectuate the sale and transfer of the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) from Seller to Developer available for use in the development of Developer's Property, including, as applicable, the utilization thereof in Developer's Prospective Building, thereby permitting the same to be of a greater size than would be permitted without the utilization thereof), (i) provide for the related grants of an easement and a restrictive covenant as more particularly set forth herein and in that certain Cantilever Easement Agreement dated as of the date hereof between the parties, (i) set forth the portion of the development rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot which may be utilized in connection with each of Seller's Property and the Developer Property, and (iv) otherwise establish, and setforth,certain rights and obligations of the parties hereto. AGREEMENT: The parties hereto, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is herebyacknowledged,herebyagreeasfollows: 1. Definitions For the purposes hereof, the following terms shall have the meanings hereinafter ascribed thereto: (a)"Allowable Development Rights" shall mean each of, or either, Seller's Allowable Development Rights and/or Developer's Allowable Development Rights, as the context requires. (b)"Alterations" shall have the meaning set forth in Section 3 hereof. (c)"Bonus Development Rights" shall mean any bonus floor area, and associated bulk and density rights, which may become appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot and available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon, through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on the Combined Zoning Lot or on real property that is not part of the Combined Zoning Lot, in accordance with theZoning Resolution. (d) “Business Days" shall mean all days except Saturdays, Sundays and the days observed as public holidays by the Federal government or the New York State or New York City governments. (e) "Combined Zoning Lot" shall have the meaning set forth in the Recitals. 2
